newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 24.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$15.82 (-0.22)

BHP is due to hold its annual meeting in Sydney at 2.30 pm (0430 GMT), with Chairman Brian Loton and Managing Director John Prescott expected to come under fire for BHP's recent profit fall. However, analysts had upgraded BHP Steel's profit outlook after a Prescott briefing on Monday, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper said.

Santos Ltd said late on Monday it had discovered another oil and gas field in Queensland. Santos said the discovery was in Queensland's Authority To Permit (ATP) 259P. A gas flow rate of 203,338 cubic metres or 7.18 million cubic feet per day was recorded in a drill stem test on in the Patchwarra formation.

News Ltd, the Australian unit of News Corp Ltd, said late on Monday it has appointed Lachlan Murdoch to the position of managing director, effective immediately. News Ltd executive chairman Ken Cowley said he would remain in his position with his primary function being strategic focus while Murdoch would focus on managing the group's operations.

Standard and Poor's said late on Monday it has affirmed the B-plus long term credit rating of TNT Ltd and has removed the rating from Creditwatch, where it was placed on November 20, 1995. "The rating outlook is positive. Despite the Ansett sale, improving profitability and cash flow are prerequisites for a future rating improvement. Profitability is likely to improve gradually, given the recent restructuring efforts," S&P said.

Property developer Devine Ltd said late on Monday it plans to build a A$120 million housing development in Collingwood Park in the western surburbs of Brisbane following the purchase of 977 allotments or 162 hectares of land.

Anzoil Ltd said late on Monday its Song Thai Binh B10-x well in Vietnam's Hanoi Basin is being suspended as a potential oil producer. The decision follows a pumping test on the well that averaged 227 barrels of oil per day over the last 6.5 hours, Anzoil said.
